"""Freeze all four V164 endpoints and eight retained native comparator columns."""
import ast
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V164-pair-unit-floor-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);previous=Path(plan['previous'])
old=previous/'postprocess-v2/scripts';post=root/'postprocess-v1/scripts';post.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for name in ['train_v43_quality_trial.py','report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet.py','profile_raw_kernel_inference.py',
    'report_checkpoint_pilot.py','train_directional_bank_trial.py']:shutil.copyfile(old/name,post/name)
shutil.copyfile(Path(plan['work'])/'scripts/review_pair_unit_floor_trial.py',post/'review_pair_unit_floor_trial.py')
for name in ['score','audit','render']:
    text=(old/f'{name}_harmonic_phase_trial.py').read_text().replace('_harmonic_phase_trial','_pair_unit_floor_trial')
    text=text.replace('V163','V164').replace('58137600','61824000')
    if name=='render':
        needle='names = ["Noisy Malvar","V143 parent","Anchor ctrl raw1k","Anchor ctrl EMA1k","Phase raw1k","Phase EMA1k"]';assert needle in text
        text=text.replace(needle,'names = ["Noisy Malvar","V143 parent","Phase ctrl raw1k","Phase ctrl EMA1k","Pair floor2 raw1k","Pair floor2 EMA1k"]')
        text=text.replace('V160 paired/V161 harmonic','V160 paired/V161 harmonic/V162 anchor')
    ast.parse(text);(post/f'{name}_pair_unit_floor_trial.py').write_text(text)
retained=dict(read(previous/'postprocess-plan-v1.json')['retained_native_collections']);assert len(retained)==7
retained['V162 anchor EMA']=read(previous/'plan-v1.json')['control_collections']['anchor-control-EMA-step1000']
cases=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations'];assert len(retained)==8
for binding in retained.values():
    assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
    collection=read(binding['path'])
    assert [r['id'] for r in collection['observations']]==[c['id'] for c in cases]
    assert all(r['parent']==c['parent'] for r,c in zip(collection['observations'],cases,strict=True))
save(root/'native-retained-comparators-v1.json',{'collections':retained,'new_forwards':0,
    'scope':'Eight retained columns:V156 raw,V157/V158/V159 EMA,V160 ordinary/paired EMA,V161 EMA,V162 EMA. Current control replays V163. Same822 input/parent bindings;no retained neural forwards.'})
shared=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103'
metrics=[shared/'collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py',shared/'collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py',
    shared/'V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py']
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=':'.join(str(p) for p in [post,Path(plan['work'])/'scripts',Path(plan['work'])/'src']),
    OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1')
command='from pathlib import Path;from score_pair_unit_floor_trial import load_module;'+f'r=Path({str(shared)!r});'
command+='load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py","errors");load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py","independent_late_spectral_metrics");load_module(r/"V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py","photos");'
command+='import review_pair_unit_floor_trial,audit_pair_unit_floor_trial,render_pair_unit_floor_trial;print("PASS actual V164 review/primary+independent metrics/render imports")'
run=subprocess.run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',command],cwd=repo,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
assert run.returncode==0,(run.stdout,run.stderr)
save(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json',{'returncode':run.returncode,'stdout':run.stdout,'stderr':run.stderr,
    'command':command,'metrics':[ref(p) for p in metrics],'retained_native_collections':retained,
    'sources':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in post.glob('*.py')},'new_forwards':0,
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print('Frozen9 postprocess sources/eight native retained columns;61824000 native RGB channels')
